## Method

Every numbered biome point is loaded from its source manifest or its committed audit table. Every point must have at least one consumer reference (`file#symbol`) that exists, a focused consumer test, and (where a profile exists) a live profile probe. A point without those references is **open** and lists exactly what is missing. The report is generated from the repository; it is not a hand-maintained wish list.

The profile probe samples a deterministic grid across seasons, weather, height, moisture and land-use flags. A point that the probe does not sample is still reported with its source/consumer evidence, but it never becomes implemented merely because an ID appears in an array: the consumer file and symbol are verified independently.

## Reproduce

```bash
cd game
npm run spec:audit
npm test
```

The generated `docs/spec-coverage.json` is the machine-readable source; `js/generated/spec-coverage.js` keeps the in-game Explore status in sync.
